title: Teller and Sakharov meet; Sakharov says Teller was right

tellings.quote: And later Teller and Sakharov actually got to meet. And Sakharov, the father of the Russian hydrogen bomb, looked at all of Teller's communications back and forth and said, "Oh, Teller was right.

plain: The physicist Edward Teller and Andrei Sakharov, the father of the Russian hydrogen bomb, eventually met, and Sakharov looked over all of Teller's back-and-forth messages and said that Teller had been right. John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that life on Mars was destroyed by nuclear war, tells this as something passed on to him. In his telling, it shows the Soviet side came to agree with Teller.
